title: Gradum Configuration
description: Configuration schema for git_stats.py quality and audit analysis.

codeExtensions.title: Code Extensions
codeExtensions.description: File extensions considered source code for analysis. Matching files contribute to add/delete totals.

nonProgrammingExtensions.title: Non-Programming Extensions
nonProgrammingExtensions.description: Extensions excluded from core source-code counting. These files still appear in total file stats but are flagged as non-core during audit checks.

excludedDirectories.title: Excluded Directories
excludedDirectories.description: Directory names completely skipped during file traversal. Supports both bare names (node_modules) and dot-prefixed names (.git).

settings.title: Runtime Settings
settings.description: CLI-equivalent settings governing analysis behavior, output destinations, and feature flags.

threadPoolSize.description: Number of parallel worker threads. Set to 0 for auto-detection (capped at CPU core count).

batchCommitCount.description: Number of commits assigned to each thread batch during parallel processing.

movingAverageWindow.description: Window size for moving average calculation in CSV output. Set to 0 to omit this column.

formulaExpression.description: Custom expression for an additional CSV column. Accepts a built-in name (net_ratio, efficiency, churn) or any Python math expression (e.g., 'add / max(deletions, 1)').

outputFilePath.description: Output path for the generated CSV file. When null, a timestamped name is auto-generated.

disableMultithreading.description: Enforce single-threaded processing, even for repositories with 100+ commits.

enableQualityAnalysis.description: Enable the 4-factor quality model (recency, anti-AI, deletion health, and scale).

batchPeriodUnit.description: Enable per-period quality analysis by partitioning commits into time windows.

reportOutputPath.description: Output path for the ZIP report containing quality charts, a radar chart, and the suspicion CSV.

qualityParamsFilePath.description: Path to a JSON file with custom quality parameters that override defaults in qualityParams.

chartPrimaryColor.description: Primary chart color, specified as a hex code or named color.

audit.title: Audit Thresholds
audit.description: Thresholds and parameters driving the 31-code suspicion and deletion audit engine.

botAuthorPatterns.description: Case-insensitive patterns matched against author names to identify bot accounts.

heroTopContributorCount.description: Number of top contributors evaluated for hero-dependency risk (S2011).

heroRiskThreshold.description: Hero score threshold below which a hero-dependency alert is triggered.

paretoMaxBarCount.description: Maximum bars displayed on the Pareto contributor chart.

netDeletionThreshold.description: Net change (in lines) threshold for flagging a commit as a heavy deletion.

deletionRatioBoundary.description: Deletion-to-addition ratio below which a project is flagged as accumulation-only (S2004).

refactoringBothLargeThreshold.description: Minimum additions AND deletions required to classify a commit as high-risk refactoring (S1001).

clusterPositionGap.description: Maximum positional gap (in commit index) between consecutive heavy deletions for them to be considered part of the same cluster.

clusterMinimumSize.description: Minimum number of heavy-deletion commits required to form a deletion cluster (S2001).

matureProjectCommitCount.description: Minimum total commits required to classify a project as mature for mature-churn analysis (S2002).

recentActivityWindowDays.description: Lookback window (in days) for considering a commit recent in mature-churn analysis.

aiAdditionsPerCommitThreshold.description: Average additions-per-commit threshold for triggering an AI volume spike alert (S2005).

aiAdditionsScaleFactor.description: Scale factor for the AI additions sigmoid in quality scoring. Larger values produce a softer curve.

aiInitiativeEarlyCommitCount.description: Number of initial commits examined when detecting AI bootstrap patterns (S2006).

aiInitiativeAddDeleteThreshold.description: Add/delete ratio threshold used in AI initiative scoring.

aiInitiativeScaleFactor.description: Scale factor for the AI initiative sigmoid.

aiRepetitionCvThreshold.description: Coefficient of variation threshold for AI uniformity detection (S2007).

aiRepetitionScaleFactor.description: Scale factor for the AI repetition sigmoid.

aiFocusTargetFiles.description: Expected average files-per-commit used in AI focus deviation analysis (S2008).

aiFocusScaleFactor.description: Scale factor for the AI focus deviation sigmoid.

tinyCommitLineThreshold.description: Maximum changed lines for classifying a commit as tiny (S3007).

recencyHalfLifeDays.description: Half-life (in days) used for recency scoring and abandonment detection (S2012).

qualityParams.title: Quality Model Parameters
qualityParams.description: Weights, thresholds, and scaling factors for the 4-factor quality evaluation model.

recencyHalfLifeDays.description: Gaussian half-life for recency scoring. At 90 days, a project scores approximately 0.61.

aiAdditionsThreshold.description: Sigmoid midpoint for the AI volume score (average additions per commit).

aiAdditionsScale.description: Sigmoid steepness for the AI volume score.

aiInitiativeCommits.description: Number of initial commits checked for AI bootstrap patterns.

aiInitiativeThreshold.description: Sigmoid midpoint for the AI initiative score.

aiInitiativeScale.description: Sigmoid steepness for the AI initiative score.

aiRepetitionCvThreshold.description: Sigmoid midpoint for the AI repetition score (coefficient of variation).

aiRepetitionScale.description: Sigmoid steepness for the AI repetition score.

aiFocusTarget.description: Sigmoid midpoint for the AI focus score (files per commit).

aiFocusScale.description: Sigmoid steepness for the AI focus score.

fireworkDensityThreshold.description: Sigmoid midpoint for the firework burst score (commits per day).

fireworkActiveDays.description: Sigmoid midpoint for the firework duration score.

fireworkDensitySlope.description: Sigmoid steepness for the firework density score.

fireworkDurationSlope.description: Sigmoid steepness for the firework duration score.

aiClaudeFactor.description: Multiplier applied to the Claude commit ratio for the Claude flood score.

deletionIdealRatio.description: Ideal deletion-to-addition ratio used in deletion health scoring.

deletionSigma.description: Standard deviation for the Gaussian deletion health scoring.

deletionDefaultScore.description: Default deletion health score assigned when no deletions exist.

scaleRefLines.description: Reference line count used as the sigmoid midpoint for scale scoring.

scaleMaxLines.description: Maximum expected project lines for scale normalization.

scaleMinScore.description: Minimum scale score assigned to very small projects.

scaleMaxScore.description: Maximum scale score assigned to very large projects.

tinyCommitThreshold.description: Maximum changed lines for a commit to be considered tiny (triggers a penalty).

tinyPenaltyMax.description: Maximum penalty deducted from the raw score for tiny commits.

tinyPenaltySlope.description: Sigmoid steepness for the tiny-commit penalty.

zombieDays.description: Days since the last commit beyond which a project is classified as archived or zombie.

baseline.description: Anchor value for confidence-based shrinkage toward neutrality.

personalityAmplitude.description: Maximum personality jitter amplitude (± percentage points).

personalityMaxLines.description: Line count at which personality jitter saturates.

weightRecency.description: Weight assigned to the recency factor in the composite score.

weightAntiAi.description: Weight assigned to the anti-AI factor in the composite score.

weightDeletionHealth.description: Weight assigned to the deletion health factor in the composite score.

weightScale.description: Weight assigned to the scale factor in the composite score.

weightHero.description: Weight assigned to the hero factor in the composite score.

suspicionLabels.title: Suspicion Level Labels
suspicionLabels.description: Display labels and colors for each suspicion severity level. Each value is a [name, rich-color] pair.

qualityBands.title: Quality Bands
qualityBands.description: Score ranges that map composite quality scores to display bands. Sorted in descending order by min score.

name.description: Display name of the quality band.

color.description: Rich color name used in console output.
